buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the

original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1- Experience Criteria: The Bidder should have regularly, Contractor of any Central / State Govt. Organization/PSU for 3 year before the bid opening date. Copies of relevant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having Work done during each of the year. 2- Bidders has to submit the EMD with Account Payee in favor of Executive officer, Nagar Palika Parishad Gangoh. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the EMD and Documents along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy of EMD and required Stamps to the Buyer before Bid Opening date. 3- ISO 9001 or Latest: The bidder must have ISO 9001: 2015 or 45001:2018, 14001:2015 4- Certification. ISO Certificate should be made before from the BID date. 5- Minimum 03 Year Experience Certificate of 10% Past performance in Govt. Department will be uploaded in the bid. (Document proof required). 6- Firm should not be blacklisted by any department. The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. (Affidavit Required from bidder on 100 rupees stamp paper) 7- Officer/Employee of Govt. Department and their blood relative are not allowed for participating in the bid. (Affidavit Required on 100 rupees Stamp Paper) 8- All Documents will be signed with seal. In Case of Copy paste signing documents and uploaded other on necessary documents, bidder may be disqualified. 9- Bidder must submit bidder Turnover for 3 financial years (2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26). 10- Bidder must also submit ITR Certificates for 3 financial years ( 2023-24,2024-25,2025-26). 11- Audited Balance sheet of last 03 financial Years (2023-24,2024-25,2025-26). with UDIN and Member No. will be uploaded by the bidder. 12- Minimum Average Annual Turnover of the bidder should be 1 Core in Last 03 FY Years. 13- Bid Compliance on 100 rupees Stamp paper will be uploaded by the bidder. 14- All Stamps and EMD in original will be submit in office before bid opening Date. Otherwise application will be disqualified. 15- Computation of income will be uploaded by the bidder of last 03 financial year ( 2022- 23,2023-24,2024-25) 16- Form 26AS for last 03 financial Year (2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26) will be uploaded. 17- Required affidavit will be uploaded during the Bid period.

18- BIDDER SHOULD HAVE SUBMITTED LAST 3 Months GST3B CERTIFICATE. (July- 2026, Aug-2026, Sep-2026). Bidder should have submitted Form 3CB-3CD as per (Audit report under section 44AB of the Income-ta x Act, 1961, in the case of a person referred to in clause (b) of sub-rule (1) of rule 6G) in last 03 financial Year (2023-24,2024-25,2025- 26). 19- Valid Character Certificate will be uploaded by the bidder. 20- Valid Hasiyat Certificate will be uploaded by the bidder. 21- MSME certificate will be uploaded by the bidder. 22- Aadhar, Pan , Gst certificate will be uploaded by the Bidder. 23- Labour Department Certificate will be uploaded by the bidder. 24- OEM authorization Certificate with Bid No. 25- Service Centre or Office of Bidder should be located in the District. .
